Military Manoeuvres Act
(Chapter 182, Section 8)
Military Manoeuvres (Firing Ground) Proclamation
Proc 4
G.N. No. S 283/1994
REVISED EDITION 1995
(1st July 1994)
[1st July 1994]
The President has by Proclamation declared that the area specified in the Schedule to be a firing ground.

THE SCHEDULE
36 Sce Eod Range
All that area comprised in part of State Land Lot 1608, MUKIM NO. 31 (CHANGI) occupied by “36 SCE EOD RANGE” containing an area of approximately 123 square metres and bounded approximately as follows:
Commencing at the northern-most corner of the building of the aforesaid “36 SCE EOD RANGE” which point is 39,001.4 metres North and 43,750.3 metres East of the Survey Department origin of co-ordinates (30,000 metres North and 30,000 metres East), the boundaries run along successive lines of the building walls of bearings and distances approximately as under:
